query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       MIN(id) as primeiro_id, 
       MAX(id) as ultimo_id,
       MIN(saleDate) as primeira_data,
       MAX(saleDate) as ultima_data
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY' 
AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(createdAt, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = '2025-12-27';
